dock.creator: site/pc/v25/nox-shell-v25.js:dock
dock.creation: legacyNav creates dock after 21 attempts at 500 ms only if .n25-navbtn is absent; existing .n25-dock prevents duplicate creation
dock.other_boot_routes: Standalone pages return; exact / or /index.html uses HOME; exact /resonance.html or /chat.html uses railNav; /pages/* uses hookPagesKit. Nested /nox-web-v29/pc/resonance.html falls into legacyNav in this historical source.
dock.explicit_hide: Only @media print hides .n25-dock in the inspected archive. V9/shared-chrome hide .nox-master-floating-dock, a different class.

page_difference.v29_chat: Historical site/chat.html does not include the V25 shell; its common nox-ui.js does not create this dock.

actual_evidence_limit.meaning: Previously authenticated native readback of common UI, not proof that bottom dock rendered.
actual_evidence_limit.root_live_browser: Root reported /nox-web-v29/chat.html displayed Your request was blocked. No UI visibility verdict or cause of blocking inferred.

next_if_accessible: Inspect actual page URL, presence/computed visibility of .n25-dock and actual loaded pc/v25/nox-shell-v25.js before applying a UI change.

current_route_proof.onehost: Current full front source preserves request URL.path, forwards to http://127.0.0.1:8080, and ASCII-decodes only query bytes. No path translation in this function.
current_route_proof.proxy_registration: Current proxy calls register_native_v29_chat(app, globals()) with no site_dir override.
current_route_proof.static_mount: Current bridge defaults directory to literal SITE, mounts authenticated _OwnerStatic at /nox-web-v29, and inserts that mount at route index0.
current_route_proof.overlay_scope: The V25 shell JS is not an owner overlay key, nox-ui.js, or nox-function-catalog.js. It follows the static file path. HTML receives native-owner.js injection and calls owner_chat_ui.decorate_html.
current_route_proof.limits: Source route proof is not an in-memory route trace. Raw file script inclusions do not prove final decorated DOM, dynamic imports or actual visibility. Historical pc/resonance and current requested chat are distinct HTML files in the same source-defined mount.

proposed_current_projection.reader: Current readonly inspector Reader.read(relative,limit), retained no-follow directory chain, owned regular single-link files, stable descriptor/path identity. Reader.guard before and after; no new lease or Reader.
proposed_current_projection.public_fields: SHA/size/file metadata; bounded local script-src path list without query/fragment/authority; named lexical dock markers. No raw HTML/JS or exception messages.
proposed_current_projection.deployment_plan: Compose only after ordinary QA in the next same-worker readonly reconciliation. Do not edit or delay the pending first inspector.
